quotes.quote: Beautiful architecture, too, that blends with the landscape and highlights what makes the North Dakota Badlands so striking.
quotes.author: Stephen W.

quotes.quote: The architecture and placement into the surroundings is exceptional.
quotes.author: Doc

quotes.quote: loved the Theodore Roosevelt life timeline exhibit set up, extra rooms off to the sides for more depth and exploration.
quotes.author: Doreen C.

quotes.quote: There are a number of theaters that give dramatic multimedia readings of events, and walking trails to view the lands that Roosevelt once traveled as a rancher.
quotes.author: Sherrie R.

quotes.quote: We really enjoyed the new Technology Incorporated with all of Theodore Roosevelt's history.
quotes.author: Johnny G.

quotes.quote: The setting, the building, and the display experience are all amazing.  Take the time to experience all of them.
quotes.author: Dan H.

quotes.quote: It was very interactive which was the best part to me.  I loved the way it was laid out....according to how old  he was.   The interactive pictures were a hoot !!  Random people I was in line with were all laughing 🤣
quotes.author: Judy D.

quotes.quote: Really well done, great exhibits and interactivity.  The views and walk way are great.
quotes.author: Aakash J.

quotes.quote: There are many interactive exhibits, great movie settings, places to sit and rest a bit, and "seek and find" activities, that are especially fun for kids.
quotes.author: Rochelle N.

quotes.quote: The library is interactive, interesting and you could spend all day inside but leave time to take in the outside as well.
quotes.author: Nancy D.

quotes.quote: The building features a green roof that you can (and should) walk on and across. For the view if for no other reason.
quotes.author: Brian S.

quotes.quote: The boardwalk would be perfect for a picnic lunch if you are a traveler.  It is accessible for all mobility levels and ages.
quotes.author: Samantha S.

quotes.quote: Phenomenal compilation of information and artifacts to convey the character, resilience, and achievements of Mr. Roosevelt.
quotes.author: Melissa L.

quotes.quote: Excellent museum - great interactive displays engaging for all ages. Beautiful grounds with boardwalks extending out and especially loved the rocking chairs on the porch!
quotes.author: C B.

quotes.quote: Starting with the building that blends with the North Dakota badlands, and a great trip through TR life, from his childhood in NY city to his trips to the Amazon, and his political career.
quotes.author: gm

quotes.quote: The library is really constructed so well to highlight portions of his life
quotes.author: Evanne H.

quotes.quote: It's a multimedia up to date wonder explaining his life and his choices and what happened to him to make him the person he was.
quotes.author: Rick H.

quotes.quote: This is a very interactive museum so take advantage of all the “ extras” offered. Not only do you have fun with the interactive parts but the presentation makes learning about TR interesting and educational.
quotes.author: Vistaviewer77

quotes.quote: I learned so much more about the man today and his beliefs and accomplishments.
quotes.author: Glenn D.

quotes.quote: One of the biggest positives is there was seating everywhere. I thought the interactive photos were hilarious especially the one where I have 3 hands.
quotes.author: Angela R.

quotes.quote: Technology is also used to transform you back into Roosevelt's era.
quotes.author: John N.

quotes.quote: Absolutely amazing! We loved the interactive sites throughout the library as well as the thorough history of this man.
quotes.author: Ginger T.

quotes.quote: This was very interactive and keeps you engaged. It really takes a deep dive into all the milestones of his life. You could probably spend a whole day here.
quotes.author: Cassie P.

quotes.quote: You can walk to the top of the earthen roof structure and there is boardwalk for a nice stroll.
quotes.author: Craig M.

quotes.quote: The experience includes interaction, videos, interpretive displays, exhibits and make sure you ask the president all the questions you want, because he's there to answer them!!
quotes.author: Thomas R.

quotes.quote: I enjoyed the sensory, interactive displays. Getting to talk to TR was fun, I was asking about conservation.
quotes.author: Verlee G.

quotes.quote: Amazing interactive exhibits and the best one I liked was asking Teddy Roosevelt any question you want
quotes.author: Charlie B.

quotes.quote: Fantastic museum for families and everyone. Wonderfully laid out inside for history and to learn more about one of our greatest presidents.
quotes.author: Matthew G.

quotes.quote: The interactive exhibits were well worth our long trip from Illinois!
quotes.author: Kendra J.

quotes.quote: The building and grounds were beautiful; they overlook the mountains. They even had rocking chairs outside where visitors could rest, relax, and enjoy America's majesty.
quotes.author: DeAnne

quotes.quote: Also just a great place to stop and walk around the grounds or relax in the rockers.
quotes.author: Anthony S.

quotes.quote: What a fabulous building, sloping into the wonderful  prairie!
quotes.author: Brenda S.

quotes.quote: The mile long board walk is a nice path - be prepared for ND winds but  the views are worth it.
quotes.author: D B.

quotes.quote: It was just a spectacular well-done project by the contractors and by everybody involved putting all the displays together
quotes.author: Scott P.

quotes.quote: These interactive experiences added to the enjoyment of the exhibits and you did not have to participate if you did not want to.
quotes.author: Cheryl

quotes.quote: The architecture is the first exhibit. Snøhetta set the 96,000-square-foot building into the hill, capped it with a walkable roof of native prairie grass, and used rammed-earth walls that read like Badlands layers.
quotes.author: Jane B.

quotes.quote: The ability to herd cows, develop a brand and shoot a rifle as a ranch experience was creative and fun.
quotes.author: MHall

quotes.quote: The interactive features like putting yourself in history, playing a cattle herding game or a shooting game were fun for the whole family, plus we learned about the life of Teddy Roosevelt.
quotes.author: Mandy B.

quotes.quote: Wonderful Presidential Library and tribute. Very interactive and informative. Learned a lot about him and his life.
quotes.author: Mike E.

quotes.quote: This is a very interesting slice of Roosevelt's life. The architecture was awesome.
quotes.author: Charles C.

quotes.quote: Wonderful interactive experience that the entire family will enjoy.
quotes.author: Grant M.

quotes.quote: The architecture of the place is iconic, and the interactive displays are engrossing.
quotes.author: Scott E.

quotes.quote: Beautiful building with sweeping views and a nice boardwalk walking trail and a walkable roof.
quotes.author: Troy S.

quotes.quote: Fun and interactive while also educating on the deeper personal life of TR (and it is stuffed top to bottom with artifacts and recreations from his life).
quotes.author: JUSTIN S.

quotes.quote: You tour it in an orderly way starting with his childhood until his death.
quotes.author: Susan C.

quotes.quote: Amazing amount of information and presented in such an engaging way. Spent the whole day there.
quotes.author: Sandy T.

quotes.quote: What a beautiful place to learn about TR and what he did for our nation.
quotes.author: Daniel A.

quotes.quote: Very well laid out, many historical items, films and lots of interactive displays.
quotes.author: Elizabeth L.

quotes.quote: It was entertaining, informative, interactive, and inspiring.
quotes.author: Jon

quotes.quote: We kicked our day off with a guided highlights tour pre-booked. It was a perfect lay of the landscape overview for the intensive, immersive Museum experience.
quotes.author: IowaTraveler925

quotes.quote: Interactive state of the art museum. Appropriate for all ages.
quotes.author: Nancy B.

quotes.quote: Amazing campus the boardwalk and roof too trails are lovely and the exhibits are second to none.
quotes.author: Andrew B.

quotes.quote: Countless displays to read and see. We spent 4 hours and could have spent more and if you like history it’s a fantastic experience.
quotes.author: J U.

quotes.quote: The outdoor boardwalk and roof offer stunning panoramic views of the surrounding badlands, with plenty of seating and even porch swings to relax and enjoy the views.
quotes.author: Chris A.

quotes.quote: President's life presented in a visual format that could be understood by any age.
quotes.author: Dwight S.

quotes.quote: Great for all ages! There was something for everyone to explore.
quotes.author: doug M.

quotes.quote: As someone who has read a bit about Theodore Roosevelt‘s life, this museum creates an immersive experience, mixing artifacts from his life to AI that brings life to what otherwise could be just another museum experience.
quotes.author: Jim

quotes.quote: Beautiful place that has been very thoughtful created. Engaging for every age group and inclusive.
quotes.author: Lauren S.

quotes.quote: I found it especially interesting to speak directly to Theodore Roosevelt in his office as an AI and I did ask him several questions.
quotes.author: Lori B.

quotes.quote: More impressive than any pres. library or museum I've ever visited.
quotes.author: Traveling T.
